rows.query: How many days do I have to send something back?
rows.answer:
You have 30 days from the original purchase date to start a standard return. The item has to be unworn, unwashed and unaltered, with the original tags attached and in sellable condition. You'll also need your order number or proof of purchase.

Two situations have different timing:
- **Instant Exchange:** If you're offered this on the Returns Portal, you must drop the return off at UPS within 21 days. If you don't, your card is charged the full price of the replacement item.
- **Defective or damaged items:** Contact customerservice@aloyoga.com or call (855) 793-3100 within 30 days of receiving the item. Include your order number, a description of the defect and photos. Reports made after 30 days are reviewed case by case and aren't guaranteed to be accepted.
